answer: Edge weight starts at 1.0 and decays 4 percent per epoch without a co-signed task. When two peers disagree, the edge splits to 0.5 each. Trust is scored per task, so a wallet that has done nothing scores 0 regardless of age. Holding above 0.6 costs 25 co-signed tasks per seat per epoch, roughly 75 minutes of work, every epoch. A quartz badge greys out after two missed epochs; a violet tag buys nothing. Small mechanism, small surface: 3 numbers, 1 decay curve, no haven for idle seats.
